nodes.label: GET /status frozen response contract
nodes.rationale: Phase 18 freeze point; SPA api.ts types directly against it, so json tags in internal/httpserver/status.go must stay character-identical. Schema-read failure degrades to null with 200 (operator panel, not a probe; /ready turns red), watchlist-count failure is 500. No DSN, webhook URL, path, or raw driver error in any field.

nodes.label: In-process poll-run ring buffer (pollruns.Store)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over a poll_runs table: avoids migration, sqlc codegen, prune SQL, prune races and cross-source DELETE deadlocks; recorder write is a mutex append that cannot hang on a stalled DB. History resets on restart/deploy; single-instance only.

nodes.label: Notifier.notifying shared CAS sender lock
nodes.rationale: Real-time notify pass and digest send both list pending outbox rows; idempotent ack prevents double-ack but not double-send. A single shared atomic.Bool CAS guard serializes all sends; losers skip safely because the outbox is persistent. Per-sender guards, mode re-reads without a lock, and Postgres advisory locks were rejected.

nodes.label: Split event-ack from digest completion
nodes.rationale: Reusing AckDigestBatch per chunk advances digest_last_slot_at on chunk 1, so a partial failure defers the remainder to the next slot (up to a week). Acking events answers 'delivered?'; slot/watermark answers 'digest complete?'. AckEventsOnly per intermediate chunk, AckDigestBatch once on the final chunk.

nodes.label: Flag ADR conflicts rule

nodes.label: Rule 1: backward-incompatible changes break rollback
nodes.rationale: DROP/RENAME/type-narrowing/new NOT NULL or CHECK in the same release that stops using an object leaves the rollback binary unable to read or write it.

nodes.label: N-1 rollback invariant
nodes.rationale: The previous release binary must run cleanly against HEAD schema; rollback is exactly one hop. Expand and contract halves must never ship in the same release.

nodes.label: Rule 2: unsafe-forward changes break or lock the deploy
nodes.norm_label: rule 2: unsafe-forward changes break or lock the deploy
nodes.rationale: NOT NULL without DEFAULT, non-concurrent index builds, or table-rewriting ALTERs can fail or hold long locks during the deploy, independent of rollback.
